offering_description.value: Manufactures consumer and industrial packaging, including metal and composite food cans, closures, rigid paper containers, protective and thermoformed packaging, and paperboard tubes, cores and cones. Sells mainly to consumer packaged goods, food and beverage, healthcare and industrial customers, made in plants worldwide largely from paper and steel.

primary_products.value: metal food and beverage cans and closures; rigid paper containers; composite cans; paperboard tubes, cores and cones; protective and thermoformed packaging

primary_services.value: contract packaging and fulfillment; packaging design and engineering support

customer_segment.value: B2B: consumer packaged goods, food and beverage makers, healthcare, textile, paper and industrial manufacturers

end_markets.value: food and beverage; consumer packaged goods; healthcare; industrial; paper and textiles

revenue_model.value: product sales: packaging products sold under supply agreements, often with raw material cost pass-through; service fees: contract packaging and fulfillment services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts steel, aluminum, recovered paper, resin and paperboard into packaging sold to brand owners and manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: Operations in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: consumer packaging, industrial paper packaging and protective packaging sharing customers and materials

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales to consumer goods and industrial manufacturers under supply contracts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food-contact and pharmaceutical packaging rules (FDA), plus environmental and workplace safety regulation of manufacturing plants

notes: Portfolio has changed recently (ThermoSafe and display packaging divestitures, Eviosys metal packaging acquisition in 2025), so the product mix may be somewhat outdated.
